$comment: Golden cases of the guild building placement window (tools/check_nui_snapshots.py): the Facility category with its second building selected and the costs met, rotation X and Y movable and Z kept still, in every theme at 100, 150 and 200%; at 100% the Objects category with the price and the stone short, and preview mode on. The modern looks' frames are larger than classic's (the 630dp window and its shadow, which the renderer offsets once it crosses the frame's right edge), so classic keeps its frames and the modern cases have their own.
